summary: You take FEMGEN 101 and 103 for a letter grade, five courses from your subplan's list, two courses from other subplans' lists, a WIM course, and either the senior capstone (FEMGEN 104X and 199A) or the honors thesis, with more FEMGEN courses for the rest of the 63 units. At most 10 of the 63 units may be CR/NC or S/NC and at most 10 may be directed reading or independent study (FEMGEN 195 and 195X). Courses from other departments count with the Faculty Director's approval and are moved in by hand, as is an individually designed subplan's approved course of study; capstone and honors proposals are approved by the instructors and your advisor. Honors adds at least 9 units of FEMGEN 199A and the other listed honors courses.

quoYAHRM.why: Capstone, Honors Thesis: "Students pursuing honors must complete FEMGEN 199A. In addition, they will complete a minimum of 9 units, including 199A, from the following course list." The list is the Honors section's (FEMGEN 199A, 199B, 199C, 104X, 105). Without the 9 units this path would take FEMGEN 199A alone, which the Senior Capstone Project path does not allow ("should enroll in FEMGEN 104X ... followed by FEMGEN 199A").
